name: Sticky Sections Stack
description: Stack of full-height cards that stick to the top while scrolling, each shrinking and lifting away as the next one arrives, with an image contrast fade and smooth scrolling.
contents: Stack of sticky cards, each with counter, image, title with lead word and short text
Optional full-screen loader shown until images are ready
behavior: Cards stick near the top and scale down while moving up as the next card covers them
Card images fade from high contrast to normal while scrolling in
Smooth scrolling through Lenis, skipped when reduced motion is preferred
Loader fades out once all images have loaded
editableByProps: Number of cards, images, titles, text and card colors
Card position, radius and image size
Scale, lift and contrast values and scroll ranges
Smooth scroll on or off and its smoothing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card layout or add a button

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Loader covers the whole viewport until images load
Cards are 80vh tall and stick in place, which needs the page to scroll past them
